header.name: Social Robotics
header.description: To introduce social robotics and human robot interaction. It will look at the distinctiveness, application domains, and interaction methods of social robots. This course will also discuss challenges and opportunities that are specific to this growing field.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to analyze the main challenges and opportunities of social robots. They will also be able to assess the design and interaction ability of a social robot.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students (individually and in groups) will develop the ability to analyze the need of the social robots in different scenarios.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to predict the possible consequences of social interaction between the human and the robots. Students will also be able to offer their own set of ELS rules for the development of the social robot.

lecture_topics: How is it different from traditional robotics and its applications
Social Robots Embodiment and Design - To be able to understood by humans
Social Robots Skill Set - To understand humans (Social Emotional Intelligence and Socio-Cognitive Skills)
Social Robots and Communication Skills - To be able to interact with humans
Human Responses to Social Robots and the role of culture is shaping perceptions of the social robot
Case Studies - Kids with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), Individuals with Intellectual Disability (ID), Elderly People
Ethical, legal and Social Implications of Social Robotics (Invited lecture by Dr. Eduard Fosch Villaronga)
